The table identifies characteristics of four gases present in the Earth's atmosphere.

GasPrimary interaction with radiation
A.NitrogenAbsorbs incoming short-wave radiation
B.MethaneAbsorbs outgoing long-wave radiation
C.OxygenReflects incoming visible light
D.ArgonReflects outgoing long-wave radiation

Which row correctly identifies a greenhouse gas and its role in the greenhouse effect?
